text: Mike Curato's Flamer was reviewed by a committee in Katy ISD and deemed appropriate for high school students in the district in March. Parents and community members still challenged it at board meetings, saying its descriptions of sex constituted “pornography.” The Hanover County School Board voted to remove Flamer from circulation on the grounds that it lacked educational suitability and was not age appropriate.
